queue.title: Restrict database service exposure to localhost or private subnet
queue.operational_risk: Immediate risk of compromise: Exposed database services — billing database listening on 0.0.0.0 exposes PHI to network traversal; SHADOW SYSTEMS
queue.expected_validation: Verify database service bound to 127.0.0.1 or 10.0.x.x; confirm UFW/iptables denies external access to port 3306/5432
queue.detail: Database listening on all interfaces: LISTEN 0      70         127.0.0.1:33060      0.0.0.0:*

queue.title: Enforce SSH public key authentication, disable passwords
queue.operational_risk: Immediate risk of compromise: Weak authentication — password-based SSH susceptible to brute force and credential stuffing; FINDING 009
queue.expected_validation: Confirm PasswordAuthentication no and PubkeyAuthentication yes in sshd -T output

queue.title: Disable SSH direct root login
queue.operational_risk: Immediate risk of compromise: SSH lateral movement — root login via SSH allows immediate privilege escalation after credential theft; CRIMSON TIDE PHASE 3
queue.expected_validation: Verify PermitRootLogin is set to no in sshd_config and sshd -T output
queue.detail: PermitRootLogin is not set to no

queue.title: Enforce password complexity via pam_pwquality
queue.operational_risk: Immediate risk of compromise: Weak authentication — default password policy allows trivial passwords; RISK REGISTER R-07
queue.expected_validation: Verify pam_pwquality module in common-password with minlen 14, dcredit -1, ucredit -1, ocredit -1, lcredit -1
queue.detail: pam_pwquality present but minlen not set to 14 (found: )

queue.title: Configure audit rules for privileged commands and file access
queue.operational_risk: Significant risk if exploited: Missing audit visibility — privileged syscall auditing catches sudo abuse, crontab tampering, and passwd file modification
queue.detail: No audit rules for privileged commands found

queue.title: Set password aging and account lockout policy
queue.operational_risk: Significant risk if exploited: Weak authentication — no lockout allows unlimited brute force; no aging allows indefinite credential reuse
queue.expected_validation: Verify PASS_MAX_DAYS 90, PASS_MIN_DAYS 1 in login.defs; confirm pam_faillock configured in common-auth

queue.title: Disable IPv4 forwarding and ICMP redirects
queue.operational_risk: Significant risk if exploited: SSH lateral movement — IP forwarding enables server-to-server pivoting; redirects enable ARP cache poisoning on flat network

queue.title: Restrict SSH access to authorized groups via AllowGroups
queue.operational_risk: Significant risk if exploited: SSH lateral movement — unrestricted SSH allows any valid account to pivot between servers; FLAT NETWORK VECTOR
queue.expected_validation: Check AllowGroups directive in sshd_config; confirm only secops and admin groups listed
queue.detail: AllowGroups is not configured; all users can SSH

queue.title: Enable ASLR and restrict kernel pointer exposure
queue.operational_risk: Significant risk if exploited: Insufficient kernel hardening — disabled ASLR enables reliable exploit development for memory corruption bugs; LYNIS AUDIT

queue.title: Configure centralized log retention and rotation
queue.operational_risk: Moderate risk, harden during next maintenance window: Missing audit visibility — short retention periods destroy forensic evidence; log-srv-01 must retain 365 days minimum
queue.expected_validation: Verify rsyslog forwarding from billing-srv-01 and web-srv-01 to log-srv-01; confirm logrotate maxage 365 on log-srv-01
queue.detail: No log retention maxage or rsyslog forwarding configured

queue.title: Enable network sysctl hardening for SYN floods and martian logging
queue.operational_risk: Moderate risk, harden during next maintenance window: Insufficient kernel hardening — SYN flood and spoofed traffic mitigation not enabled; MISCONFIGURATION ANALYSIS
